text: Compile is explicit and incremental; unchanged docs recompile byte-identically with zero model calls.
Every feature/scenario is grounded by verbatim quotes on known chunk handles; ungrounded drafts are dropped.
Doc text is untrusted, delimited data; extraction output cannot carry config, policy or off-catalog fixtures.
Coverage reports uncovered and notTestable chunks.
Rejected scenarios are never re-proposed.
Oversized sections split deterministically at headings, then chunk boundaries.
Ids and review states survive recompiles via reconciliation; a changed fingerprint resets review.
Staleness is by chunk hash with move relocation; `--frozen` exits 4 on stale plans.
Pinned features are never overwritten.
Plan and recording files are deterministic (stableJson, posix, LF, no timestamps) and path-safe.
The doc criterion (judge) is the oracle; recordings are persisted only for passing scenarios.
Determinism is demonstrated by probe + confirm runs; failures reclassify to fuzzy or mark the scenario unstable.
Every `FuzzyReason` is produced by a tested condition.
Recording reuse is prefix-valid; driver major changes invalidate.
Healed is distinct; `--strict` fails it; the heal threshold demotes to fuzzy.
Recordings are never written in read-only mode (CI default); `-u` re-characterizes.
Selector round-trip; replay requires a newly-true, stable effect.
Change checks must be discriminative; invariant checks are allowed only by classification rules.
Volatile literals and probe-volatile nodes are rejected.
The predicate DSL has no regex; evaluation is linear.
`--audit` fails on check/judge disagreement.
The judge never sees actor output (type + canary).
Samples, thresholds, inconclusive band, spread rule, contradictory samples.
Screenshots reach models only when untainted or proven masked.
Action and model-call budgets.
Deterministic target-ambiguity rule.
Policy enforced in runner, actor and driver; write-ahead action log.
Page content is untrusted, delimited data; injection cannot cause off-policy actions or passes.
Data preconditions need validated fixtures, else blocked with a stub.
Redaction everywhere; secret values never in config/reports; minimum length.
Taint after secret fill.
Settle with busy detection; unsettled screens are never judged.
Session isolation, maxSessions, exclusive resources.
Exit codes.
CI defaults.
Synchronous plan loading for collection-time registration.
CLI and integrations use only public entry points.
Session injection through `sessionFactory`.
Content-addressed artifacts; `verify-run` detects modification (documented threat model).
